expectations.evidence: no differences in citations, numbers, math, cross-references, quotes, markup

verdict=preserved: The revision removes filler ("It is important to note that", "It should be noted that", "Furthermore", "Moreover") and tightens phrasing. All claims, hedges ("to the best of our knowledge, somewhat underexplored", "should consider"), the qualifier "novel", the citations, the 5-9% figure, and the 1.2 million count stay attached to the same claims at the same strength; dropping "in the existing literature" does not change scope, because "underexplored" already refers to the literature.
